cases.prompt: A fictional fabrication dossier combines worst-case and RSS stacks, computes Cpk across an unstable pooled lot, counts repeated gauge readings as independent parts, and calls a high-yield supplier lot production_approved despite missing MSA, open nonconformance and an unnamed release role. Write an integrative design review that recomputes the relevant public CSV values and restores every evidence boundary. End only with synthetic_review_complete if every fictional gate is satisfied or evidence_gaps_remain with a hold otherwise.

rubric.criterion: Separates hard service constraints, process–structure–property evidence and route trade-offs without machine settings or unsupported qualification
Recomputes worst-case and independent RSS distinctly, rejects undeclared independence and links datum/fit evidence to inspection
Withholds Cp/Cpk for unstable or improperly pooled records and counts actual parts rather than repeated gauge readings
Recomputes public lab and rehearsal clearances, capability and yields with correct lot structure and accepted-part denominators
Audits drawing/BOM, risk, supplier-lot, control-plan, first-article, nonconformance and change-control evidence without treating templates as approval
Uses only synthetic_review_complete or evidence_gaps_remain, holds every missing/open gate, and requires real qualified review and named authorized human release outside the course

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic fictional evidence; it is not a grade, qualified engineering/statistical/standards review, supplier approval, achieved fabrication readiness or production release.
